decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed variation of condition to extend the opening hours of the existing public house would result in unacceptable harm to the living conditions of the adjoining residents, by reason of prolonged noise and disturbance associated with patrons visiting the premises and activity carried out within the premises. The proposal would therefore be contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), ENV-P.1.5 (Noise pollution) and S.1.4 (Non-retail uses in locations outside primary and secondary frontages within the main shopping areas).

Condition : 2 - Informative: The planning application submitted refers to 84-86 Staines Road, whereas the public house occupies 84, 86 and 88 Staines Road and has been registered and assessed as such.
description: Variation of Condition 3 (opening hours) of permission 01054/84-86/P12 to allow Pub to open 9am - 12.30am Sunday to Thursday and 9am - 1.00am Friday to Saturday
